tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. The base canvas both Coach and Viewer modes sit on.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Card and panel background, one step up from the page — drill cards, plan blocks, the viewer's printable sheet background.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Recessed/inset surfaces — input fields, the drag-and-drop practice-plan tray, hover rows in dense Coach-mode tables.

tokens.name: ink-100
tokens.usage: Primary text. Body copy, headings, drill names.

tokens.name: ink-200
tokens.usage: Secondary text — timestamps, metadata, drill durations, helper copy.

tokens.name: border-100
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers between cards, table rows, and drill blocks.

tokens.name: border-200
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and outline buttons: the edge someone has to find to tap. 3:1 against surface-100 in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11), where border-100 is a hairline for dividers only.

tokens.name: rink-100
tokens.usage: Primary brand color — an ice-rink teal-blue, not a hockey-jersey red. Primary buttons, active nav state, links, selected drill-variant chip.

tokens.name: rink-200
tokens.usage: Pressed/hover state for rink-100 actions, and the darker tint used for Coach-mode chrome (header bar, dense toolbar).

tokens.name: whistle-100
tokens.usage: Secondary accent — a warm parka/whistle orange, used sparingly: 'Add drill', progression-step highlight, the onboarding-flow progress indicator. Never used as a page background or for large fills.

tokens.name: good-100
tokens.usage: Positive/success semantic — feedback-loop 'great practice' signal, saved confirmations. Kept hue-distinct from rink and whistle so it never reads as a third brand color.

tokens.name: flag-100
tokens.usage: Warning/error semantic — missing required onboarding field, expired viewer link. Distinguishable from whistle-100 by both hue and lightness, never used interchangeably with it. Reserved strictly for warning/error states — do not reuse for neutral diagram marks or any other decorative purpose; use role-defense-100 for a neutral 'other role' mark in rink diagrams.

tokens.name: role-defense-100
tokens.usage: Neutral diagram role color — the defending team/backchecker marks in rink diagrams (DrillDetail and Viewer breakout diagrams). A plain structural color with no semantic meaning (not warning, not brand, not status), so it never collides with flag-100 (warning) or rink-100 (brand/primary).

tokens.name: rink-ice
tokens.usage: RinkDiagram ice surface. A hair off white so the rink reads as a surface on a white page; never used outside diagrams.

tokens.name: rink-boards
tokens.usage: RinkDiagram boards outline and nets. The darkest rink element, so the rink shape is recognisable at thumbnail size.

tokens.name: rink-line-red
tokens.usage: RinkDiagram red markings: centre line, goal lines, faceoff circles and dots, crease outline. A quiet tint on purpose so players and paths dominate; diagram-only, never a UI or warning colour.

tokens.name: rink-line-blue
tokens.usage: RinkDiagram blue lines and centre circle. Quiet tint, diagram-only.

tokens.name: rink-crease
tokens.usage: RinkDiagram goal-crease fill.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Page titles — 'This Week's Practice', season setup screen title.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings — drill-library category, plan block header.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Primary reading copy in Viewer/Parent mode — printable sheet body text, drill descriptions.

styles.name: body-md
styles.usage: Default UI copy in Coach mode — dense lists, table cells, form labels.

styles.name: mono-data
styles.usage: Numeric/data display — drill duration counters, season date ranges, the AI-context-snapshot debug view.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest gap — icon-to-label, chip internal padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Compact gap — form-field internal padding, dense Coach-mode row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default internal padding for cards and buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between stacked elements — form fields, list items.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section spacing within a page.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Spacing between major page sections; Viewer-mode breathing room.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page-level top/bottom margins, hero sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, drill blocks, inputs — the default control radius for containers. Buttons use radius-full instead.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modal sheets, the Viewer-mode printable plan card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: All buttons (primary, secondary, accent), avatar, icon-only buttons, status dots — the default shape for anything tappable, pairing with the brand's curved drill-path motif.

shadow.note: Shadows are reserved for things that are actually floating above the page — a dragged drill, an open menu, a modal sheet. A card at rest uses border-100, never a shadow, to keep the resting UI flat and calm; a shadow appearing is itself the signal that something has lifted off the page.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: The smallest lift — a Card on hover, signalling it's tappable, without implying it has left the page.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popovers and dropdown menus — content that opens above the page but stays anchored to where it opened from.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modal sheets, the season-setup onboarding flow, and a DrillCard mid-drag while a coach is reordering the plan — the clearest 'this has left the page' state in the system.

focus.note: Keyboard-focus styling, applied via :focus-visible (never plain :focus, so a mouse click doesn't trigger a ring). Added because an audit found zero focus-visible styling anywhere in the system — every interactive element (buttons, chips, stepper segments, drill cards) must resolve to this token rather than relying on browser default outlines or inventing a one-off ring per screen.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The one focus-visible treatment for the whole system — buttons, chips, stepper segments, drill cards, nav links. A rink-100-tinted outer ring via box-shadow so it doesn't shift layout, applied through :focus-visible.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons and controls — drops opacity rather than desaturating color, so state reads correctly in both themes.

tokens.name: opacity-overlay
tokens.usage: Modal and sheet backdrops, reserved for the onboarding/season-setup flow once it has a dedicated component.

tokens.name: opacity-hover
tokens.usage: Subtle hover-tint overlays on flat rows — Coach-mode dense list hover state — layered on top of surface-300 rather than replacing it.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Default page content.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Popovers and dropdown menus (pairs with shadow-md).

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: The Coach-mode dense toolbar and the drill-library search panel when pinned on desktop.

tokens.name: z-dragging
tokens.usage: A DrillCard while actively being dragged, so it renders above neighboring rows (pairs with shadow-lg).

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modal sheets and the season-setup onboarding flow (pairs with shadow-lg and opacity-overlay).

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Save confirmations and error toasts — always above everything else, including an open modal.
